note:
Position profile DURING training, not just at step 0. Every alpha and slope measured so
far comes from step 0, before any optimizer step, and that is the largest remaining caveat:
the collapse runs reach mis_kl 0.8 to 14, roughly 250x the step-0 level, and there is no
evidence that the position structure of the error is the same once it has grown that far.

These cells train for 14 rollouts with the fp8 e5m2 amplification that drives collapse, and
dump per-token logprobs the whole way. That gives alpha and the slope as functions of step,
so the step-0 result can either be shown to persist or be scoped to the pre-training state.
Either outcome is worth having; the current claim is simply untested outside step 0.

cells.name: e5m2_train
cells.note: fp8 e5m2, 14 steps, dumping throughout. The arm that collapses.
